career.heading: One company since 2017
career.intro: Since September 2017 I have been with one company: Kamino, which Netcetera acquired in 2023, now G+D Netcetera. Each title is split into its technical and its leadership part.

paths.heading: Two paths, one career
paths.intro: The technical path follows what I build. The leadership path follows the people and the delivery I am responsible for. Both run through the same company and the same years.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.text: I’m open to remote-first and hybrid roles where I can lead mobile teams and take responsibility for delivery. Email is the best way to reach me.
